title: Approval Required email of a billable estimate shows the line at $0.00
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a portal contact for this test for customer A, whose portal login and email the tester can use.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours and line 2 of 1.5 hours marked No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Send to Portal.
  3. Open the "Approval Required" email in the contact's mailbox.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The estimate is sent.

Step 3:

  • Line 2 shows $0.00 with "Goodwill"; line 1 shows $240.00 and the total is $240.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order), story SV-12296 (Story 12 (portal), The no-charge line in the customer portal)

  • S2-R11: “Parts ordering, receiving, picking, clock-ins, approvals, notes, inspections, split and review work exactly as on a billable work order. On an internal work order "Send to Portal" and "Request IBS Approval" are not shown. On a no-charge work order "Send to Portal" works for the estimate as today (the document carries NO CHARGE; the portal estimate shows lines, hours and part quantities on its line cards (on no-charge estimates only; billable cards stay as today) with no prices, no cost and no total, the NO CHARGE stamp and the category line of S2-R16, and Approve and Decline work as today) and is not shown once the work order is closed; "Request IBS Approval" is not shown. The "Approval Required" email follows the page: on a no-charge estimate no amounts or totals, the stamp and the category line instead; on a billable estimate a no-charge line at $0.00 with its category.”
  • S12-R4: “The work order carries no badge and no header style and its classification stays billable; Financial Info (the cost view) does not change. Totals, tax, work order fees and discounts, deposits, the estimate, the portal approval and the Customer PO are computed on the billable lines; the no-charge line shows at $0.00 on the estimate and in the portal with its category under the title. A line discount on the line is removed when it is marked and not restored by Mark as Billable. A deposit on the work order does not block the mark; when, after the mark, the deposit exceeds the billable total, the dialog says "Deposit $[amount] exceeds the new total $[total]. The difference stays on the customer's account as a deposit when the invoice is created." and the existing rule applies at invoicing. An estimate already on the portal shows the live work order when the customer opens it (same link, no new email; the advisor re-sends when a fresh document is wanted), with the line at $0.00 and its category under the title and the notice "This estimate changed after it was sent. The lines above are current."; a pending IBS request is not withdrawn (ShopView has no withdrawal); as after any price change today, the advisor requests approval again with the new amount when needed. ShopView renders the estimate and invoice documents and the portal shows them; the portal renders its own approval line cards, price summary and emails, where the $0.00 line shows with its category: that portal side is its own story, SV-12296, linked to SV-12226.”
